login.error: Logging in with your passkey failed. Please try again or log in with your password.
login.errorThrottled: Too many login attempts. Please wait a moment.

profile.title: Passkeys
profile.description: A passkey lets you log in without a password, using your fingerprint, face or device PIN.

register.errorPassword: The password you entered is incorrect.
register.errorThrottled: Too many attempts. Please wait a moment.
register.error: The passkey could not be added.
register.unsupported: Your browser does not support passkeys.
register.errorLimit: You have reached the maximum number of passkeys. Please remove a passkey first.
register.confirmWithPasskey: As the password login is disabled, you first confirm adding a passkey with one of your existing passkeys.

delete.confirmText: Do you really want to remove the passkey %name%? You will no longer be able to log in with it.

mail.subject: A new passkey was added to your account
mail.preHeader: A new passkey was added to your customer account.
mail.text: a new passkey was just added to your customer account:
mail.ifYou: If this was you, there is nothing else to do.
mail.ifNotYou: If this was not you, please remove the passkey in your account right away and change your password:

passwordLoginDisabled.subject: Password login disabled for your account
passwordLoginDisabled.preHeader: The password login was disabled for your customer account.
passwordLoginDisabled.text: the password login was just disabled for your customer account. From now on, you log in with your passkey only.
passwordLoginDisabled.ifNotYou: If this was not you, please use "Forgot password" on the login page right away. This enables the password login again. Then check your passkeys:

passwordLoginEnabled.subject: Password login enabled again for your account
passwordLoginEnabled.preHeader: The password login was enabled again for your customer account.
passwordLoginEnabled.ifNotYou: If this was not you, please change your password right away and check your passkeys:

reason.customer: the password login for your customer account was just enabled again in your account settings.
reason.recovery: the password login for your customer account was just enabled again, because your password was reset via "Forgot password".
reason.lastPasskeyRemoved: the password login for your customer account was just enabled again, because the last passkey was removed.
reason.administration: the password login for your customer account was just enabled again by our customer service.

passwordLogin.description: Do you only log in with passkeys? Then you can disable the password login for your account. A stolen password is then no longer enough to access your account.
passwordLogin.disabledInfo: The password login is disabled for your account, you only log in with passkeys. Using "Forgot password" enables the password login again automatically.
passwordLogin.disabledSuccess: The password login has been disabled.
passwordLogin.enabledSuccess: The password login has been enabled again.
passwordLogin.reEnabledLastPasskey: As you have no passkey left, the password login has been enabled again.
passwordLogin.disableConfirmText: Do you really want to disable the password login? Afterwards, you log in with your passkey only. You can enable it again at any time using "Forgot password".
passwordLogin.enableConfirmText: Do you really want to enable the password login again? Your account is then accessible with your password again.
passwordLogin.confirmWithPasskey: For your security, you confirm the change with your passkey afterwards.
passwordLogin.errorConfirmation: The confirmation with your passkey failed. Please try again.

error.TINECT_PASSKEYS_PASSWORD_LOGIN_DISABLED: The e-mail address can not be changed while the password login is disabled. Please enable the password login in the "Passkeys" section first.
